page.overview:
Who is Klara?

Klara is a rival appearing in Sword - The Isle of Armor Expansion Pass. She only appears in Pokémon Sword, and her Pokémon Shield counterpart is Avery. She specializes in types.

Klara is a slender young woman with fair skin, blue eyes, and pink hair. She also wears pink lipstick and eye shadow and has a mole under her mouth. She wears a wild, unique outfit with many accessories, including a white fur coat, a white and blue moth-like bow with pink circles on it, and a dark purple and green uniform. Her uniform consists of a multicolored collared shirt and dark blue shorts with the number 881 on them. Both her shirt and shorts also have quite a few designs and unique prints on them. For accessories, Klara wears a white bracelet on her left wrist, a Dynamax band on her right wrist, a thumbless purple and black glove on her right hand, and a white ring on her left hand. On her feet, she wears pink and white shoes with blue heels and knee-length stockings that have the same colors as her clothes.

Klara adores popularity and will put on a cutesy act just to win bystanders' attention. However, beneath her smiling face is a calculating mind that she will put to good use. Klara will not be afraid to use any underhanded tactics to ensure a victory, as seen during her last battle where she sabotaged the battlefield by deploying Toxic Spikes. This led to her downfall where Mustard, who already knew about Klara's cheating, sentenced Klara to care for the Dojo's Pokémon for six months.

Klara was a pop singer before becoming a Pokémon Trainer, though she was unsuccessful in promoting herself beyond selling eight copies of her first album. To become more popular, she decided she would try to become a Gym Leader, however she gave up after attempting for two days. She soon discovered the Master Dojo from a television program, and decided to try it out, thinking she wouldn't have to put in much effort in order to get stronger there.
